data.name: Madhur maheshwari
data.player_statement:
A complete player, Madhur maheshwari has made a big mark in cricket. With 26 turns at the crease, they've hit a top score of 80*, with an average of 30.56 and a quick strike rate of 200.73. Their knack for hitting big shots is evident with 53 sixes and 34 fours.

Equally good at bowling, they've bowled 44.4 overs, taking 22 wickets at an economy rate of 7.12. Despite a few wides, their accuracy is top-notch, making them a key player for their team.
